## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem you are trying to solve. What
pain point or missing capability prompted this request?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you would like to see, including how you
envision using the feature.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Impact

Who would benefit from this feature, and how? Please note if it also matters for
self-hosted deployments.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or references about the feature request
here.

## Willing to Contribute

Are you willing to submit a pull request implementing this feature? If so, please
share your proposed approach and test plan.
